lead.headline: Senegal's government foreign-debt payments due in 2026 equal 54% of its 2024 export earnings, top of 108 poorer countries
lead.number: $4.44B scheduled for 2026 = 54.0% of 2024 exports; Bhutan 50.2%; median of 108 low- and middle-income countries 8.4%.
lead.watch_out: One ~$1.06B bond payment due in 2026 is what puts Senegal ahead of Bhutan; on 2027 or the 2026-28 average it drops to #2. The World Bank publishes this ratio itself.
